questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or direction changes, and increase your distance from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you are allowed to use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right. There is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. Stay on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top as green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used to communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: When a yellow "Exit only" panel appears on a sign, the lane below it leaves the highway. If you are in that lane and stay in it, you must exit. You can change lanes to go through the interchange instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means the operator is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you to a traffic signal ahead. Be ready for yellow lights, red lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is approaching. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill coming up. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out to the side, it means the operator is turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Operators use hand signals instead of turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward, it means the operator is turning right or changing lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. Watch carefully for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road may be wet and slippery. Drive carefully in wet conditions.
